_note: Proposed topic leaves for app/schema/topics.json from the 'western' sourcing round (2026-10-20). root = parent node in the existing tree (or a new root when root == id). keywords are case-insensitive regex fragments, word-bounded, same convention as topics.json kw. 'leaf' only tells the sourcer's tagger which confidence to use. Not yet merged into the app vocabulary.

topics.label: The soul
topics.why: Platonism, Neoplatonism, Gnosticism, Christian mysticism, Theosophy/Anthroposophy and the Fourth Way all argue about the soul; it is the Western counterpart to the existing 'self' (anatta) node and should sit beside it so heats can compare an immortal soul against not-self.

topics.label: Gnosis
topics.why: Knowing by transformation (Gnostic, Platonic and Vervaeke's participatory knowing). Close to 'awakening' but a distinct claim: liberation through knowledge.

topics.label: Prayer & contemplation
topics.why: Christian and Neoplatonic practice lands here, so cross-tradition 'Meditation' heats can include it without forcing it into 'breath' or 'guided'.

topics.label: The divine
topics.heat: God and the divine: compare takes
topics.why: No node for God or the divine exists; Western clips need one. Krishnamurti clips on 'Does God exist?' meet Eckhart, Proclus and Dionysius here.

topics.label: The One
topics.why: Plotinus' and Proclus' first principle, Parmenides' One, Eckhart's ground.

topics.label: Reincarnation in Western thought
topics.why: Myth of Er, Pythagoras and the Orphics, Plotinus, Steiner and Theosophy on karma and reincarnation, and Krishnamurti's rejection of it; a sibling of rebirth/samsara so Buddhist and Western rebirth clips can share a heat but still be told apart.

topics.label: Karma in Western esotericism
topics.why: Steiner's karma lectures and Theosophy borrow the word with a different mechanism; tag separately, roll up to 'Karma'.

topics.label: Freedom
topics.why: A main Krishnamurti theme (freedom from the known, conditioning) with no current node.
